notablePrerequisites: Next of Kin attached to Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sakashima, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to put Sakashima into the command zone from your graveyard.
Next of Kin triggers, putting Sakashima from the command zone onto the battlefield as a copy of Boonweaver Giant.
Sakashima enters the battlefield, returning Next of Kin from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sakashima.
Repeat.

uses.name: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
uses.cardState: as a copy of Boonweaver Giant
